newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers well-enquired but prices stable.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers well-enquired but prices stable.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Friday were little changed from Thursday in spite of healthy enquiries, traders said.
Most traders agreed the number of enquiries have improved from Thursday but prices were still holding steady while supplies remained adequate to meet demand.
Majors were quoting 180-cst at $128 and 380-cst at $124 per tonne. Independents were lower at $121-$122 for 380-cst and at $124-$126 for 180 cst.
MDO prices were stable at $223-228, gas oil at $235-$238.
